The foundation is a rectangle with outside dimensions of 48 ft x 40 ft. It has a 6 in CMU foundation wall, 4 ft high, with no openings. Use 8 in x 16 in (nominal) CMUs.
Q1. How many CMUs must be purchased, including 6 % waste?
Q2. If every cell is grouted, how many cubic yards of grout are needed, including 5 % waste? A fully grouted 6 in CMU takes 0.17 ft³ of grout.
Q3. If only the cells with vertical reinforcement at 32 in on center are grouted, how many cubic yards of grout are needed, including 5 % waste?

The foundation is L-shaped; going around the outside face of the wall, its sides are 30 ft, 20 ft, 14 ft, 16 ft, 16 ft, 36 ft. It has a 6 in CMU foundation wall, 8 ft high, with no openings. Use 8 in x 16 in (nominal) CMUs.
Q1. How many CMUs must be purchased, including 3 % waste?
Q2. If every cell is grouted, how many cubic yards of grout are needed, including 10 % waste? A fully grouted 6 in CMU takes 0.17 ft³ of grout.
Q3. If only the cells with vertical reinforcement at 32 in on center are grouted, how many cubic yards of grout are needed, including 10 % waste?
